arxiv-2111-12878.title: Multiway Non-rigid Point Cloud Registration via Learned Functional Map Synchronization Thanks: J. Huang and S.M. Hu are with the BNRist, Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University. Shi-Min Hu is the corresponding author. T. Birdal and L. J. Guibas are with Stanford University
arxiv-2111-12878.creator: Jiahui Huang, Tolga Birdal, Zan Gojcic
arxiv-2111-12878.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jiahui Huang, Tolga Birdal, Zan Gojcic. We present SyNoRiM, a novel way to jointly register multiple non-rigid shapes by synchronizing the maps that relate learned functions defined on the point clouds. Even though the ability to process non-rigid shapes is critical in various applications ranging from computer animation to 3D digitization, the literature still lacks a robust and flexible framework to match and align a collection of real, noisy scans observed under occlusions.

arxiv-2112-02212.title: Hierarchical Neural Data Synthesis for Semantic Parsing
arxiv-2112-02212.creator: Wei Yang, Peng Xu, Yanshuai Cao
arxiv-2112-02212.description: Abstract Semantic parsing datasets are expensive to collect. Moreover, even the questions pertinent to a given domain, which are the input of a semantic parsing system, might not be readily available, especially in cross-domain semantic parsing. This makes data augmentation even more challenging.

arxiv-2204-09444.title: Effective models of non-singular quantum black holes
arxiv-2204-09444.creator: M. Cadoni, M. Oi, A. P. Sanna
arxiv-2204-09444.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Cadoni, M. Oi, A. P. Sanna. We investigate how the resolution of the singularity problem for the Schwarzschild black hole could be related to the presence of quantum gravity effects at horizon scales. Motivated by the analogy with the cosmological Schwarzschild-de Sitter solution, we construct a broad class of non-singular, static, asymptotically-flat black-hole solutions with a de Sitter (dS) core, sourced by an anisotropic fluid, which effectively encodes the quantum corrections.

arxiv-2405-11565.title: Collisional damping of wave modes in ion-electron plasmas
arxiv-2405-11565.creator: J. De Vadder \aff 1 \corresp, J. De Jonghe \aff 1,2, R. Keppens \aff 1
arxiv-2405-11565.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. De Vadder \aff 1 \corresp, J. De Jonghe \aff 1,2, R. Keppens \aff 1. To expand on recent work, we introduce collisional terms in the analysis of the warm ion-electron, two-fluid equations for a homogeneous plasma at rest. Consequently, the plasma is now described by six variables: the magnetisation, the ratio of masses over charges, the electron and ion sound speeds, the angle between the wave vector and the magnetic field, and a new parameter describing the electron-ion collision frequency.

arxiv-2409-14900.title: Big Bang Nucleosynthesis constraints on resonant DM annihilations
arxiv-2409-14900.creator: Pieter Braat, and Marco Hufnagel
arxiv-2409-14900.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pieter Braat, and Marco Hufnagel. We perform a systematic study of BBN constraints from photodisintegration for scenarios in which dark-matter annihilations are resonantly-enhanced. To this end, we implement and make available a new class ResonanceModel within an updated version v1.3.0 of ACROPOLIS . While the corresponding implementation is done in a rather model-independent way, we also make available three benchmark models that can be used to calculate constraints for more concrete scenarios.

arxiv-2510-03837.creator: Shen Fan✉, Przemyslaw Musialski
arxiv-2510-03837.description: Abstract We propose a simple, data-efficient pipeline that augments an implicit reconstruction network based on neural SDF-based CAD parts with a part-segmentation head trained under PartField-generated supervision. Unlike methods tied to fixed taxonomies, our model accepts meshes with any number of parts and produces coherent, geometry-aligned labels in a single pass.

pmc-12656257.title: Are There Sex Differences in Lower-Limb Biomechanics and Muscle Activation During Rope Jumping in Muay Thai Athletes?
pmc-12656257.creator: Torsak Kaewjaratwilai, Niromlee Makaje, Monchai Chottidao
pmc-12656257.description: Sex-related differences in lower-limb biomechanics and neuromuscular strategies during rope jumping remain underexplored, particularly in combat-sport athletes. This study investigated leg stiffness and muscle activation in ten female (22.8 ± 0.8 years) and ten male (22.9 ± 1.4 years) Muay Thai athletes. Participants performed rope skipping under three conditions: dominant leg, non-dominant leg, and double leg at 2.2 Hz.

pmc-12688261.title: LIVER-R study protocol: a global real-world study of durvalumab-based regimens in patients with hepatobiliary cancers
pmc-12688261.creator: Masafumi Ikeda, Marcus-Alexander Wörns, Mehmet Akce, Chiun Hsu, Niall C. Tebbutt, Andrea Casadei-Gardini, Janvi Sah, Mufiza Farid-Kapadia, Heide A. Stirnadel-Farrant, Michael J. Paskow, Boris Baur, Giovanni Melillo, James Schmidt, Anna Daktera, Jennifer J. Knox
pmc-12688261.description: BackgroundDurvalumab-based regimens have improved outcomes compared with standard of care in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC) and advanced biliary tract cancer (aBTC) clinical trials. Here we describe the protocol for the LIVER-R study, which will evaluate long-term outcomes with durvalumab-based regimens in patients with hepatobiliary cancers in real-world settings.

pmc-12742769.title: The absence or the pharmacological blockade of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor promotes neuroprotection in the hippocampus after an ischemic insult
pmc-12742769.creator: Rolando Castañeda-Arellano, Lucia García-Lara, Quetzalli D. Angeles-López, Francisca Pérez-Severiano, Guillermo Elizondo-Azuela, Sergio H. Dueñas-Jimenez, Sirenia González-Pozos, Irene G. Aguilar-García, Jose Segovia
pmc-12742769.description: The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a transcription factor that acts as a nuclear receptor mediating xenobiotic metabolism and environmental responses. Recent evidence suggests that the AhR is implicated in maintaining homeostasis or triggering pathological effects by modulating different physiological responses in the nervous system. However, the underlying mechanisms of the AhR-induced effects in the hippocampus remain unclear.

pmc-12935291.title: Reducing Educational Bias in Cognitive Assessment via Dynamic Support Vector Machine Weighting: Validation Study on an Education-Stratified Dataset
pmc-12935291.creator: Qing Liu, Chi Ma, Mengyuan Liu, Suhui Chen, Mengting Yu, Lijuan Xia, Qi Zhang, Ming Wu
pmc-12935291.description: BackgroundThe Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) remains widely used for cognitive screening, yet its performance varies substantially across educational backgrounds. Linear education corrections fail to capture the nonlinear interference patterns among subitems.ObjectiveThis study aimed to analyze how educational level shapes MMSE subitem contributions and to develop an education-adaptive optimization strategy using support vector machine–based weighting.

pmc-13069739.description: Nano-pesticides represent a significant technology advancement in modern agricultural, offering improved target specificity and reduced chemical load. However, their potential to induce subtle, sub-lethal disturbance in soil microbial function remains poorly resolved and is not adequately capture by conventional indicators such as microbial diversity, abundance, or bulk enzymatic activity.

pmc-13475859.creator: Soyoung Kim, Hoonsub So, Hyun Woo Park, Sangwoo Park, Seung Bum Lee, Soe Hee Ann, Sung Wook Hwang, Young-Jee Jeon, Eun Ji Park, Woon Jung Kwon, Seong Hoon Choi, Seok Won Jung, Sung-Jo Bang, Gyung-Min Park
pmc-13475859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Additionally, the association between gallstones and subclinical coronary atherosclerosis has not been clearly elucidated. Therefore, this study aimed to analyze the association between gallstones and subclinical coronary atherosclerosis based on the type of coronary artery plaque in asymptomatic Koreans using coronary computed tomography angiography.

pmc-13581925.creator: CaiNi Wu, XueYing Wang, JiaJia Li, ShaoHua Yang, Xue Cong, Yi Jin
